methodology: Scope of passages is editorial metadata. It does not modify the primary transcription, establish book/chapter alignment or assert equivalence between translations.

entries.validation: provisional editorial scope based on opening, closing and subsequent distinct contents in historical source; review against the source table of contents before chapter-level collation

excludedRanges.type: other works of Apuleius included in the source anthology

entries.noteEs: Solo t22–t245 se identifican aquí con la novela Metamorfosis. El PDF/libro histórico fuente también incluye paratextos y otros escritos de Apuleyo. La correspondencia con los 351 loci latinos sigue sin cotejarse. La fuente completa permanece intacta en el repositorio.
